content.en: The **World Trade Organization (WTO)** was established in 1995 following the Marrakesh Agreement, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). It operates on the principles of **Most-Favoured-Nation (MFN)** treatment and **National Treatment**, ensuring non-discrimination in international trade. For the **Indian Economy**, the WTO serves as a platform to negotiate market access and resolve trade disputes.
